Formalize within the coaching plan the existing written-feedback agreement between Priyanka and Marcus, requiring written feedback within 24 hours of any contentious meeting.

Include a facilitated repair conversation between Priyanka and Marcus as part of the coaching plan to address the strained follow-through and rebuild effective working relationship.
Review progress at the end of the 45-day coaching period to assess whether interpersonal conduct has improved and whether the practical adjustments have been effective before determining next steps.
